description: Energy Odds (paper mode, free): the forecast logged in advance for a public EIA number and target date: median, 5/25/50/75/95% quantiles, probabilities above thresholds, model version, EIA inputs with timestamps, forecast_id and hash. Never computed on request: if nothing was logged it returns not_found. Status stays "unproven" until the series passes a published scoring gate. Statistical information only, not advice. [always free — no API key required]

apiKey.description: Optional existing EnergyAI key for hosts that cannot change Authorization headers. Use it to retain account identity for discovery and get_builder_upgrade_link after a trial. Removed before tool execution and persistence. Omit when the Bearer header is attached; never show the key to the user.

caller_market_price.description: Optional: a price you already have for "above threshold". Compared in this response only; never stored or logged.

quantity.description: Henry Hub only: 'high' or 'low'. Omit for both.

target_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Gasoline: the Monday of the EIA weekly price. Crude: the week-ending Friday. Henry Hub: the Monday starting the week. energy_calendar lists valid upcoming dates.

thresholds.description: Optional values to get P(value > threshold) for, computed from the logged quantiles.

name: energy_forecast
